TargetPaper.title: TargetPaper
TargetPaper.description: An exam target paper created and published by the admin, containing structured sections and questions for students to view and download offline.

title.description: Display title of the target paper

classLevel.description: Class, grade, or exam level (e.g. 10th Class, MDCAT)

examTerm.description: Exam session or term (e.g. Annual Board 2026)

externalPdfUrl.description: Optional external PDF or resource URL

createdByUid.description: Firebase UID of the admin who created the paper

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

SupportConfig.title: SupportConfig
SupportConfig.description: Admin-managed WhatsApp channel link and clickable helpline phone numbers displayed to all students.

isPublic.description: Whether the support configuration is visible to signed-in students

whatsappChannelName.description: Display name of the WhatsApp Channel

whatsappChannelUrl.description: Clickable HTTPS URL of the WhatsApp Channel

sscGroupName.description: Display name of the SSC (IX/X) WhatsApp session group

sscGroupUrl.description: Clickable invite link for the SSC (IX/X) WhatsApp session group

hscGroupName.description: Display name of the HSC (XI/XII) WhatsApp session group

hscGroupUrl.description: Clickable invite link for the HSC (XI/XII) WhatsApp session group

supportNote.description: Helpful message shown above support numbers

helpContacts.description: List of clickable help phone contact entries

updatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the admin who last updated support settings

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

AdminEntry.title: AdminEntry
AdminEntry.description: Trusted admin role record managed by the bootstrapped owner.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Student user preferences stored privately per authenticated user.

/target_papers/{paperId}.description: Published target papers readable by signed-in students; drafts and all writes restricted to admins.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Support settings document holding WhatsApp channel URL and clickable help numbers.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin allowlist entries managed by the bootstrapped admin.
